name: WdHeaderFooterIndex
description: Returns the specified header or footer in a document or section.

constants.name: wdHeaderFooterPrimary
constants.description: Returns the header or footer on all pages other than the first page of a document or section.

constants.name: wdHeaderFooterFirstPage
constants.description: Returns the first header or footer in a document or section.

constants.name: wdHeaderFooterEvenPages
constants.description: Returns all headers or footers on even-numbered pages.
